old_content: Dr Jeremy Sun completed MOH HMDP fellowship training in Tokyo focused on lymphedema surgery, including lymphovenous bypass / LVA, lymphatic imaging and complex lymphatic reconstruction. His assessment emphasises diagnosis first: determining the cause of swelling, whether the limb is fluid-dominant or solid-tissue-dominant, whether conservative care has been optimised, and whether lymphatic imaging suggests surgery is reasonable.
